newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB Jan debenture coupon seen at 2.15 pct--bankers.
newsitem.headline: NCB Jan debenture coupon seen at 2.15 pct--bankers.

text.p: The coupon rate for the new five-year bank debenture to be issued by Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) in January is expected to be left unchanged at 2.15 percent, banking sources said on Thursday.
This compares with a coupon rate of 1.6 percent for the Industrial Bank of Japan's (IBJ) January bank debentures.
As a result, the spread between the coupon rate of NCB and IBJ debentures will remain unchanged at 0.55 percentage point.
The coupon rate for NCB's bank debentures was cut to 2.15 percent in December from 2.25 percent in November
Banking sources said NCB was also likely keep its long-term prime rate unchanged at a record low 2.5 percent.
The IBJ announced on Wednesday that it would keep its long-term prime rate unchanged in January at 2.5 percent.
NCB will officially announce the coupon rate for the January five-year bank debenture and its long-term prime rate at 2 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Thursday.
